data.exact_reserve_text: The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2013 Year of Account Reinsurance to Close
prior_year_events.impact_description: total recognised profit of GBP 6.3m on closure of 2013 YOA
deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures; reserves have nonetheless been strengthened

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a strengthening in prior year reserves, primarily due to deterioration in the earned and booked position on some accounts, particularly within certain Marine Insurance segments. The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio also exhibited deterioration, leading to strengthened reserves. While the 2013 Year of Account closed with a net profit of GBP 6.3m due to reinsurance to close arrangements, the overall prior accident year experience was described as less benign.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross claims development triangle is considered unreliable for computing prior year development due to the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2013 YOA into the 2014 YOA, effective 31 December 2015, which distorts the underlying development. The narrative explicitly states 'deterioration' for prior accident year experience, but no gross amount is quantified for this overall movement. The RITC for 2013 YOA resulted in a net profit of GBP 6.3m, which is a specific net release, but does not represent the overall gross prior year development.
